subject: GPU slot economics — weekly alignment (pipeline-triggered allocations)
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: GPU slot economics — weekly alignment (pipeline-triggered allocations)

Team —

Quick note ahead of today's ops cadence: Nimbus Labs has signaled an accelerated close window for two pilots (see attached snapshot). They expect ramp to production in Q3 and are explicitly asking for a dedicated slot bundle (reserved capacity + burst) with predictable latency SLAs.

As discussed last week, we need to align on:
- Which reserved slot tranche we can commit to by end of May (three-month lookahead)
- Unit economics (cost-per-slot) for sales & finance to use in the SOW
- Fallback / burst plan if slot demand exceeds committed capacity in month 1

Please reply with the following before 4pm PT:
1) Infra: realistic commitable slot count and earliest provisioning date.
2) Finance: target blended cost-per-slot for the SOW (including amortized hardware + ops).
3) Sales: one-page mutual action plan to put in the deal so procurement can move faster.

I attached the latest pipeline snapshot and a working slot-economics workbook (v3). Ben, can you update the per-deal expected token burn by EOD so karts has accurate inputs?

Thanks — let's keep this tight; Nimbus is time-sensitive and their legal team is pingable once we have numbers.

— Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Sales, Enterprise
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: pipeline_snapshot_20270511.pdf (pdf)]
[Attachment: slot_economics_workbook_v3.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 10:24:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: GPU slot economics — weekly alignment (pipeline-triggered allocations)

Stephanie / team —

Short answer up front: we can commit an initial tranche of 40 reserved slots (A100-equivalent) for Nimbus with a provisioning lead time of ~3 weeks if we prioritize the Q3 pool. We can open another tranche of 20 slots on a 30-day notice if demand materializes.

Details / constraints:
- Current utilization in the Q3 pool is at ~62% (sustained) — we have ~120 slots free but ~80 of those are earmarked for other committed deals with later start dates.
- Provisioning path: prioritized placement on the shared dedicated fleet with guaranteed network egress in us-west-2.
- Contingency: if actual token burn exceeds projections by >25% month-over-month, we recommend a temporary burst policy: autoscale to spot-type instances with degraded latency SLAs (fall back to best-effort).

Action items for us (infra):
1) Tentatively reserve 40 slots and mark them as "Nimbus pending" in the pool management sheet.
2) Provide an internal playbook (provisioning runbook + expected IP ranges) for the security review.

I updated tab "InfraInputs" in slot_economics_workbook_v3.xlsx with realistic throughput numbers and latency band estimates.

— Karthik
Director, Infrastructure & Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference
[Attachment referenced: slot_economics_workbook_v3.xlsx (updated: InfraInputs tab)]

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 12:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: GPU slot economics — weekly alignment (pipeline-triggered allocations)

Thanks Karthik — that provisioning cadence is reasonable. A couple of follow-ups from Finance perspective:

1) We need a blended monthly cost-per-slot figure that includes: depreciation (hardware), rack/network amortization, ops headroom, and expected support credits for SLA (if any). Can Infra provide an "all-in" monthly number per reserved slot and per burst slot?
2) For the SOW, procurement will want a 90-day hard cap on monthly committed costs and a clear definition of what counts as "burst" (i.e., degraded latency, potential throttling).

If Infra can give the all-in numbers by EOD, I will:
- Populate the financial section of the MSA attachment (draft)
- Draft a price table for the SOW and send to Stephanie for approval

One note: from prior pilots, Nimbus expects token-based billing for overage rather than a percent-of-slot model. We should surface both options.

— Laura Bennett
Head of Finance, Sales Partnerships
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: GPU slot economics — weekly alignment (pipeline-triggered allocations)

Forwarding updated burn numbers and close probabilities for the two Nimbus pilots.

Attached: slot_economics_workbook_v3.xlsx (SalesInputs tab updated)
- Pilot A: expected steady-state token burn ~1.2B tokens/month starting month 2; prob close 70% in June.
- Pilot B: expected steady-state token burn ~450M tokens/month; prob close 45% in July with an initial soft-commit in June.

HubSpot deal links: https://hubspot.redwood.ai/deals/DL-2027-0841 (Pilot A), https://hubspot.redwood.ai/deals/DL-2027-0842 (Pilot B)

Ben included a simple per-deal scenario table in the workbook (low/medium/high). If finance wants the token-overage priced, I sketched a $0.0005/token overage baseline (we can refine).

— Ben Carter
Sales Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: slot_economics_workbook_v3.xlsx (updated: SalesInputs tab)]

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evan Marsh <evan@nimblabs.ai>, Procurement <procurement@nimbslabs.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: GPU slot economics — weekly alignment (pipeline-triggered allocations)

Thanks everyone — good progress. Recap / next steps so we can hand this to Nimbus procurement tomorrow morning: 

1) Infra: reserve 40 slots (marked Nimbus pending). Provide the one-page provisioning playbook + estimated all-in monthly cost-per-reserved-slot by 9am PT tomorrow.
2) Finance: draft SOW price table with both reserved-slot monthly rate and token-overage fallback. Laura, please include a 90-day hard cap option and clear burst definition.
3) Sales ops: Ben to attach the low/med/high consumption scenarios to HubSpot deals and label Pilot A as priority.
4) Stephanie: I will send Nimbus the mutual action plan and the redlined SOW once the finance numbers are in.

Evan — looping you in so procurement sees the timeline: we plan to hand over the provisioning playbook + price table by 9am PT tomorrow. If your legal/procurement team prefers a pre-call, Jordan can run a 20‑minute sync today at 5pm PT.

If anyone hits a blocker, flag it in the thread and I'll escalate to Revenue Ops.

Best —
Stephanie
Head of Sales, Enterprise
Redwood Inference
